sentences.text: 2. The prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected vide order dated 01.11.2023 passed by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge under POCSO Act, Angul in Special (POCSO) Case No. 42 of 2023.

3. Mr. M. Pagal, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 31.05.2023 and the cognizance has been taken vide order dated 15.09.2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 450, // 2 // 376-AB, 506, 341, 354-A, 354-B, 511 of IPC read with Section 10 of POCSO Act.
4. Considering the nature of the allegations against the petitioner and the age of the victim girl, I do not consider this a fit case to release the petitioner on bail and reject his prayer.
